Why: The synopsis says plan 92 set out "to move Claude Code–only facts into a file of their own, correct claims the guide doesn't support, and settle the skill's open conformance entries," aiming "to restamp its stale `cc-guide` citation so that `cli.py lint` reports no `STALE` lines." This matches the spec's goals and its "drift backlog has one file left" reason.

B2: PASS
Why: The order is: the new `claude-code.md`, then trimming `discovery.md`/`SKILL.md` to point to it, then micro-tests of those pointers, then the RED control, then the register update (which depended on the RED result), then the restamp last. No part comes before a part it needs. The first diff fact is that the RED control "came back null, so that slot was not added" (specs/deferred_items.md: "closed on a null RED run"). The second is the register's "one widened" deviation (build/cc_guide/conformance.toml: `description-when-only` artifacts gained `skills/writing-skills/references/discovery.md`).

B3: PASS
Why: "For the first time since plan 43, the project lints clean, and the last of the drift sweep's stale-file reviews is closed." The lint no longer flags writing-skills as STALE, so that item no longer ages into blocking merges.

B4: FAIL
Contradicted: "`specs/baseline/red-baseline-writing-skills-guide/new/P1a-sonnet/rep5.json` begins its reply with your first name" against specs/deferred_items.md: the new backlog item says that rep "addresses the owner by surname".
